questions.question: A person lent certain sum of money at the annual rate of 30 percent on simple interest. In 4 years , the interest amount to Rs 1100 more than the sum lent. What is the sum lent?
questions.questionHtml: A person lent certain sum of money at the annual rate of 30 percent on simple interest. In 4 years , the interest amount to Rs 1100 more than the sum lent. What is the sum lent?
questions.solution:
Let the Sum lent be 100
Interest after 4 years = 4(30) = 120
(120 – 100) units = 1100
1 unit = 55
100 units = 5500
So, the sum lent = Rs. 5500

questions.questionHtml: The initial ratio of income and expenditure of Deepak is 9 : 5 respectively. His income is increased by 5 percent and expenditure is increased by 15 percent. If his new savings are ₹ 37000, then what was the initial income of Deepak?
questions.solution:
Income - Expenditure = savings
Let Initial 900 500 = 400
New 945 575 = 370

370 unit = ₹ 37000
initial income of Deepak = 900×100 = Rs 90,000
